title: Minifix
description: Just a few small features I think should be in the game!
body:
Just a small Vanilla+ mod perfect for any Modpack!

Adding simple features like:
Witherbones
Nethershroom Stew
2 New music discs
A new nether structure


In future updates, Witherbones will replace regular bones in the Wither Skeleton loot table, but for now they drop alongside eachother.

Made with MCreator
